title: Buyer Guide - Phase 1
useFor: Finding where relevant categories are located before adding confirmed exhibitors
doNotUseFor: Creating confirmed exhibitor records by itself
Inventing company names, hall numbers, or booth numbers
Treating product zones as individual exhibitors

entranceGuidance.summary: The Phase 1 guide shows multiple Canton Fair Complex gates, not a single entrance. Choose the gate or registration route closest to the first area you plan to visit, then follow onsite signage and security directions.
entranceGuidance.martinSuggestedStart: For Martin's current targets, start with Area D because Industrial Automation and Intelligent Manufacturing, Processing Machinery, Service Robots, and some Smart Life / electronics-related zones are there.
notes: Use Area D first for automation, processing machinery, service robots, and translation-device research.
Use Area A next for general machinery, mechanical basic parts, agricultural machinery, and related equipment.
Only add Area B or Area C if confirmed exhibitors or specific product zones become relevant.

referenceZones.notes: The guide also references Smart Life halls in Area A. Use this as a lead for translation devices and smart wearable research, then confirm individual exhibitors separately.
Includes industrial robots, industrial automation systems, electronic control systems, intelligent logistics and equipment, CNC machine tools, and additive manufacturing equipment.
Use as a search area for machinery exhibitors. Confirm individual booth records separately.

referenceZones.category: General Machinery and Mechanical Basic Parts
referenceZones.notes: Useful for general machinery, small machinery, and mechanical basic parts research.
May be useful for material handling or machinery suppliers depending on Pete or Martin's focus.
Useful for tools, hardware, and related industrial supplies. Confirm details against exhibitor data before adding booth cards.
Special zone for service robots. Treat as navigation context unless confirmed exhibitor-level details are available.
